newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in evening.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in evening.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates remained quietly steady on Tuesday in moderate trade, dealers said.
"The market was quietly steady while traders waited for fresh factors from the wake of London market. Term rates stay firm with not much action seen," a local dealer said.

The April leading indicators forecast in the U.S showed the index moving up 0.1 percent. The BTM/Schroders with effect 31 May is seen moving down slightly by 1.5 percent. The Redbook with effect 31 May index showed an increase of 0.5 percent.
Day-to-day and week-fixed rates were unchanged from Monday's common 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, respectively.

Among term rates, one month was unchanged from Monday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, four months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six months remained at 6 5-7/8 and twelve months eased 1/16 point at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent.
